commands.title: AccessFS: Add Access Objects to Workspace

scripts.compile:vba-server: npm run generate:vba-parser && tsc -p src/vbaLanguageServer/tsconfig.json && esbuild src/vbaLanguageServer/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --outfile=out/vbaLanguageServer/server.js
scripts.generate:vba-parser: antlr-ng --define language=TypeScript --generate-visitor true -o ./src/vbaLanguageServer/antlr/out/ ./src/vbaLanguageServer/antlr/vba.g4 && antlr-ng --define language=TypeScript --generate-visitor true -o ./src/vbaLanguageServer/antlr/out/ ./src/vbaLanguageServer/antlr/vbapre.g4 && antlr-ng --define language=TypeScript --generate-visitor true -o ./src/vbaLanguageServer/antlr/out/ ./src/vbaLanguageServer/antlr/vbafmt.g4
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
